WITH r AS (
  SELECT r.*, p.sku, p.subcategory AS sub_was, p.category AS cat_was, cp.subcategory AS sub_now, cp.category AS cat_now
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
    AND (p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' OR cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture')
)
SELECT reason_code, sub_was, sub_now, count(*) lines, count(distinct return_line_id) ids, count(distinct sales_line_id) sl, sum(quantity_returned) units,
  sum(CASE WHEN sl.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan,
  sum(CASE WHEN sl.sale_date > r.return_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned > sl.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) overqty
FROM r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line sl ON sl.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT d.fiscal_week, count(*) lines, sum(r.quantity_returned) units,
  sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', r.return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <> r.return_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) date_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE staff_purchase_flag) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff_lines
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product cp0 ON cp0.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = cp0.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-27' AND DATE '2026-09-06'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, 'Garden Furniture' AS subcategory, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id <> 999
